items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: No, George Jones. George Jones and Cornelius! They was two buddies.

ctx.x: No, George Jones. George Jones and Cornelius! They was two buddies. George Jones was fat, a little fat cat like Abbott and Costello, but fatter than them. And Cornelius was a sleepy-eyed cat, you know, like that other cat that worked with Costello [SIC: HARDY] . What's the name of the guy who always does... Stan...Stan...Stan... Stan... Stan Laurel. One of them kind of cats that, you know, they was pickin' on. It would look like George gave him hell, and he's playing all the time.
But you had all those different kind of cats, and you'd see them on the street.
